tables.title: E17. One-role decks against the best deck, by rule variant (wiosenna)
tables.measured: planner vs planner. Columns 2 to 7: win rate of a deck heavy in one role (or one real team) against the best deck from the same veteran collection, 400 games each; the rows of one column share seeds and collections. Then the comeback rate and ganks landed per side per match in the mirror (800 games), and the veteran's win rate against a new player (800 games, 200 collection pairs). A deck far above 60% here is a dominant deck.
